posts.text: No other mammal is known to do what the naked mole rat does without oxygen: 18 minutes in a zero-oxygen chamber, then it walks away. #Zoology
comments: The fuel is fructose instead of glucose, which skips the exact step where normal glycolysis stalls. Plants use the same pathway.

posts.text: Cats cannot taste sweet. At all. The cat staring at your dessert wants something, but it is not the sugar. #Cats
comments: A mutation disabled their sugar taste receptor long ago. They are one of the only mammals that physically cannot taste sweetness.

posts.text: Hagfish slime is mostly not hagfish. One tail pinch makes about 0.9 liters, seven times the animal's own volume. #Ocean
comments: It releases a little dense exudate that captures seawater and expands up to 10,000 times in about 400 milliseconds.

posts.text: Mike the Headless Chicken was anatomy, not a miracle. A chicken's brain stem sits low and back, angled into the neck, and the axe left it behind. #Chickens
comments: The axe also missed the jugular, and a clot formed fast enough to stop him bleeding out.

posts.text: A chameleon's tongue briefly pulls more G-force than a fighter pilot can withstand. #Reptiles
comments: It reaches a full body-length away and snaps back with prey in a fraction of a second.

posts.text: Giraffes are not silent. They hum at night, around 92 Hz, well inside human hearing. It took 947 hours of recordings to notice. #Wildlife
comments: That also undoes the popular claim that giraffes talk in infrasound. 92 Hz is not infrasound.

posts.text: Male seahorses gestate. The pouch seals, the embryos embed in his tissue, and the wall works like a placenta. #Ocean
comments: The twist: a mammal's placenta grows from embryonic tissue. A seahorse's is converted skin.

posts.text: A dog's nose is estimated at 10,000 to 100,000 times more sensitive than yours, and the wetness is part of the design. #Dogs
comments: The moisture traps scent chemicals so they can be analyzed more effectively.

posts.text: Light pollution has a measurable cost, and dung beetles measured it. Two meters in 40 seconds under the Milky Way, close to two minutes under cloud. #Insects
comments: Without the stars a beetle keeps turning, covering far more ground for the same distance.

posts.text: An Alaskan wood frog survives freezing to at least -16C. The same species farther south tops out around -3C to -6C. #Amphibians
comments: The difference is mostly urea banked in autumn, roughly eight times as much in subarctic frogs, stockpiled before any ice appears.

posts.text: Some sea cucumbers defend themselves by ejecting their own organs out their rear end, then growing a new set in weeks. #Ocean
comments: The ejected organs are there to confuse predators.

posts.text: That palm-sized clownfish can live around 30 years, roughly twice any other coral reef damselfish. #Ocean
comments: So a low-ranked fish waiting for a breeding slot may genuinely be queuing for decades.
